title: Change the details on a pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence
summary: You can change the details on your pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence at a Service NSW Centre or by email.
intro: If you need to change the details on your pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence, such as your address or surname, you can do this at a Service NSW Centre or via email.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for Licence Amendment'
Copy of a name change document, such as a marriage certificate or change of name certificate (if applicable)
A signed letter that identifies the details that need to be changed (if not covered by the form)

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and submit your application in person at a Service NSW Centre, or by email using the details on the form.

faqs.q: How can I change the details on my pawnbroker or second-hand dealer licence?
faqs.a: You can change the details at a Service NSW Centre or by email.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to change my licence details?
faqs.a: You need the 'Application for Licence Amendment' PDF form, a copy of a name change document (if applicable), and a signed letter identifying the details that need to be changed (if not covered by the form).
